Impedance-Controlled Trace Widths
The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` is a 4-layer board, and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` contains the USB_DP_DM, ETH_MDI, and HDMI_TMDS net classes. Use KiCad 10.0.2; run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path). For this task, the installed KiCad tools are `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/pcbnew`, and `/usr/bin/eeschema`; use the one that matches the board or schematic operation.

Apply these specified fabrication-approved differential settings: USB_DP_DM width 0.13 mm and gap 0.10 mm; ETH_MDI width 0.10 mm and gap 0.15 mm; HDMI_TMDS width 0.10 mm and gap 0.15 mm. Do not infer alternate values from the stackup.

Update the HDMI_TMDS pair on F.Cu to 0.10 mm segment width with source-side spacing about 0.25 mm, and place exactly six GND stitching vias in the HDMI trace region with maximum pitch 5 mm. Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`.
